name: Sacred Sites and Pilgrimage Routes in the Kii Mountain Range
description: Deep in the forested Kii Mountains of Japan, overlooking the Pacific, three sacred centers (Yoshino and Omine, Kumano Sanzan, and Koyasan) are tied together by old pilgrimage trails leading to Nara and Kyoto. Walkers pass shrines, streams and waterfalls where Shinto nature worship and Buddhism blended, some shrines dating to the 9th century. The paths are still walked today.
